answers.rationale: Erin has accepted a Thursday evening nonstop when the workshop ends with a substantial airport buffer and no material-handling complication. A 2:30 p.m. finish, 25-minute airport trip, no rental, no checked equipment, and a 7:10 p.m. nonstop support using Thursday and preserving Friday calls.

The late Thursday end, checked demo case, rental return, 45-minute drive, winter advisory, and approved hotel night collectively make a Thursday departure fragile. Erin has moved to Friday when late hands-on work, equipment, and weather remove meaningful airport margin.

With no equipment or rental, confirmed bag storage, a sponsor dinner ending at 8:15 p.m., and a meaningful Friday family appointment, the 10:30 p.m. nonstop is the calibrated same-day option. Erin has treated useful evening work events as worth a later nonstop when logistics are controlled rather than applying a blanket extra-night rule.
